race.description: Family Of League Race Day, Sunday 22nd November Mdn Hcp
race.comment: HURKLE DURKLE (4) is worth following up second-up after making a strong return at Townsville when missing narrowly. Has enough pace to offset the wide alley and keeps Morrison. Can get off the mark this time. PARADING GUS (2) returns and while he's found the maiden win elusive, it certainly hasn't been without trying and there's a handful of efforts littered through his form that line up well for this. Is drawn favourably for Whiteley and can make a bold statement fresh. WATCH THE FORT (1) was okay when returning in tough conditions at Home Hill. Fitter now but will need a clever steer. EMPRESS IRENE (3) returns and steps out in new colours. Mixed her form back in NSW but a recent trial suggests she has come back in well enough to be competitive off a long break. Keeping safe in the minors.
